# Placeholder. cixd renders the real contents of this file from
# /v1/dhcp state and stages it into this container at creation, before
# dnsmasq starts -- so what dnsmasq opens is always current.
#
# It must EXIST at creation even when empty: dnsmasq refuses to start on
# a --conf-file that is not there, and a DHCP server that will not start
# is a worse failure than one serving no ranges.
#
# Ranges are read only at startup, so changing one restarts this
# container (the reservations file below is re-read on SIGHUP instead,
# and updates live).
